title: A Survey on Benchmarks of Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on culturally diverse visual question answering benchmarks (e.g., CVQA, Henna) to assess their understanding and representation across different global cultures and to identify Western-centric disparities.
Testing models on multilingual multimodal benchmarks (e.g., MTVQA, CMMMU, LaVy-Bench) to measure capability gaps and performance disparities across various non-English languages.
Assessing models' reliance on non-essential input attributes and spurious correlations rather than true causal features using specialized diagnostic benchmarks (e.g., MM-SPUBENCH, CorrelationQA).
